meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí xià. Placed after an action verb to make a request or suggestion sound casual and brief (看一下, 等一下).

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 台阶上放着一个用白纸包着的小木盒。
examples.trans: A small wooden box wrapped in white paper was sitting on the steps.

examples.text: 哪怕只有一个客人入住，我们也会准备好热腾腾的早饭。
examples.trans: Even if only one guest checks in, we still prepare a piping hot breakfast.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān shí. Cardinal number thirty ('three tens'); pairs directly with measure words like 三十年 ('thirty years').

examples.text: 这棵老树在院子里长了三十年。
examples.trans: This old tree has grown in the courtyard for thirty years.

examples.text: 从客栈走到地铁站只要三十分钟。
examples.trans: Walking from the inn to the metro station takes only thirty minutes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià. Used for downward motion ('go down'), location ('under'), or 'next' (下周).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Standard negation for present/future/habitual verbs and adjectives; shifts to bú before a 4th tone (不是 bú shì).

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

meanings.note: Pinyin: liǎng. Used instead of 二 when counting things with a measure word (两个, 两把, 两间).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè. Most common Mandarin measure word (量词), placed between a number/demonstrative and a noun (一个人, 这个).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng yāng. Compound 中 ('middle') + 央 ('center'); also used in music for the middle register (中央八度 'middle octave').

examples.text: 院子中央摆着一张干净的木头圆桌。
examples.trans: A clean round wooden table stands in the center of the courtyard.

examples.text: 请把手放在钢琴键盘的中央。
examples.trans: Please place your hands at the center of the piano keyboard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng jiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 正中间 ('the exact middle').

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

examples.text: 两栋砖房中间是一个安静的小院。
examples.trans: Between the two brick buildings lies a quiet small courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǔ chú. Combines 主 ('chief/head') + 厨 ('cook/kitchen'); measure word: 位 (wèi).

examples.text: 小美主厨坐在两个枕头上，用木勺指挥整个厨房。
examples.trans: Head Chef Mei sat propped on two pillows, directing the whole kitchen with a wooden spoon.

examples.text: 这位年轻的主厨最擅长烤酥脆的杏仁柠檬挞。
examples.trans: This young head chef specializes in baking crisp almond lemon tarts.

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: èr shí bā. Cardinal number 二十 ('twenty') + 八 ('eight'); becomes ordinal with 第 (第二十八 'twenty-eighth').

examples.text: 这首曲子的第二十八小节非常温柔。
examples.trans: The twenty-eighth bar of this piece is very gentle.

examples.text: 二月通常只有二十八天。
examples.trans: February usually has only twenty-eight days.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liàng. Describes bright light or a surface polished clean (擦亮 'polish bright').

examples.text: 隔壁的小洗手间呢？灯亮吗？
examples.trans: What about the small bathroom next door? Does the light work?

examples.text: 火苗亮了——稳稳的蓝火，正合适。
examples.trans: The flame is lit—steady blue fire, right as it should be.

examples.text: 这样吧，还是由我来亲自讲。
examples.trans: How about this — let me explain it myself instead.

examples.text: 这样吧，还是由我来亲自讲。
examples.trans: How about this — let me explain it myself instead.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cóng. Marks a starting point in space or time (从早上到晚上 'from morning to night').

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ. Everyday singular 'you' among colleagues, friends, and peers; use 您 for polite respect.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ men. Plural 'you' for addressing two or more people (including polite groups).

examples.text: 太谢谢你们两位了。
examples.trans: Thank you both so very much.

examples.text: 不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
examples.trans: It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàng. Introduces a likeness or example ('look like, be like').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 他长得真像他哥哥。
examples.trans: He really looks like his older brother.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a part used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个儿。
examples.trans: I have a 儿.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的儿。
examples.trans: This is a very good 儿.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guāng. Rays of light or brightness (阳光 'sunlight', 灯光 'lamplight').

examples.text: 早上的光从玻璃窗照进阳光房里。
examples.trans: Morning light shines through the glass windows into the sunroom.

examples.text: 换上新灯泡以后，屋子里的光很柔和。
examples.trans: After putting in the new bulb, the light in the room is very gentle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liáng. Describes pleasantly cool air or hot water/food that has cooled down (放凉).

examples.text: 谢谢你，小美。刚才吓了一跳，手都凉了！
examples.trans: Thank you, Mei. That gave me such a start just now that my hands went cold!

examples.text: 摸摸热水管——下面是温的，上面变凉了。
examples.trans: Feel the hot-water pipe—the bottom is warm, while the top is turning cool.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jǐ. Asks about small numbers (几点 'what time', 几个 'how many') before a measure word.

examples.text: 真的？您不介意多爬几步楼梯？
examples.trans: Really? You do not mind climbing a few extra stairs?

examples.text: 那家五金店早上几点开门？
examples.trans: What time does that hardware shop open in the morning?

出炉.gloss: come fresh out of the oven

meanings.en: come fresh out of the oven
meanings.note: Pinyin: chū lú. Literally 'exit the oven' (刚出炉 'freshly baked').

examples.text: 刚出炉的：星期五柠檬蛋糕，多切了边角！
examples.trans: Fresh from the oven: Friday lemon cake, with extra corner pieces!

examples.text: 第一盘肉桂卷刚从烤箱出炉。
examples.trans: The first tray of cinnamon rolls has just come out of the oven.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēn. Counts clock minutes (五分), test/review points (十分), and currency cents.

examples.text: 十、十一、十二。一分不差，谢谢！
examples.trans: Ten, eleven, twelve. Exact to the last cent—thank you!

examples.text: 我手表七点二十九分。客人下楼了。
examples.trans: Seven twenty-nine on my watch. Guests are coming down the stairs.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāng. Placed right before a verb to show the action happened moments ago.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

examples.text: 一到七号钥匙全拿走了，八号房刚刷了油漆。
examples.trans: Every key from one to seven is taken, and room eight just got fresh paint.

meanings.note: Adverb gānghǎo ('just recovered/happened; just right').

examples.text: 你病刚好，千万不能生气。
examples.trans: You have only just recovered from illness and must not get angry.

examples.text: 我到车站的时候，地铁刚好进站。
examples.trans: Right when I reached the station, the train pulled in.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuā. Used for painting walls, brushing, or swiping a card.

examples.text: 一到七号钥匙全拿走了，八号房刚刷了油漆。
examples.trans: Every key from one to seven is taken, and room eight just got fresh paint.

examples.text: 周末我们要刷院子里的木门。
examples.trans: This weekend we are going to paint the wooden courtyard gate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shèng. Describes time, items, or money remaining (只剩五分钟 'only five minutes left').

examples.text: 而且他今晚八点到这里——只剩四十分钟了！
examples.trans: And he arrives here at eight o'clock this evening—in forty minutes!

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

meanings.note: adjective praising sharp skill or impressive ability

examples.text: 那就太好了，好厉害！
examples.trans: Then that is wonderful — you are amazing!

examples.text: 这位制作人在业内非常厉害。
examples.trans: This producer is really formidable in the industry.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qù. Movement away from the speaker, as main verb (去车站) or directional complement (上去).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.en: mouth; doorway; measure word for sips/breaths
meanings.note: Pinyin: kǒu. Counts mouthfuls of food/tea, breaths of air (一口气), or family members.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

examples.text: 宋老师早上好！看昨晚大门口送来了什么。
examples.trans: Good morning, Teacher Song! Look what arrived at our front gate last night.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ. Read zhǐ as the adverb 'only' before verbs, and zhī as a measure word for cups, boxes, and small animals.

examples.text: 而且他今晚八点到这里——只剩四十分钟了！
examples.trans: And he arrives here at eight o'clock this evening—in forty minutes!

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

meanings.note: Pinyin: ké yǐ. Polite modal verb for asking or granting permission (可以吗？ 'Is that alright?').

examples.text: 真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
examples.trans: Is that really alright? It looks both lovely and warm!

examples.text: 阁楼书房？我可以先上去看看吗？
examples.trans: An attic study? May I go up and see it first?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hào. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个号码 ('a number').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ya. Gentle exclamation of surprise or realization.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 呀，这就是星期一火车上那只双胞胎箱子吗？
examples.trans: Oh, is this that twin suitcase from Monday's train?

meanings.en: we; us; our (inclusive of both the speaker and the listener)
meanings.note: Pinyin: zánmen. Unlike 我们 (which can exclude the listener), 咱们 specifically includes the person spoken to, creating a warm, collegial, or colloquial tone. Directly modifies nouns without 的 in set expressions like 咱们这行.

examples.text: 干咱们这行，谁不想跟他学习？
examples.trans: In our line of work, who wouldn't want to learn from him?

examples.text: 淳于总已经批准咱们的方案了。
examples.trans: Director Chun Yu has already approved our proposal.

meanings.note: Pinyin: āi yā. Expresses mild dismay or sudden surprise.

examples.text: 我的眼镜怎么会在……哎呀！在我头上！
examples.trans: Why would my glasses be in... oh dear! They are on my head!

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
examples.trans: Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?

meanings.note: Pinyin: la. Colloquial fusion of 了 + 啊 adding cheerful energy at the end of a sentence.

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 你们守着，我出门啦！
examples.trans: Hold the fort—I am heading out the door!

meanings.note: Pinyin: sì. Cardinal number 4.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.en: see you later; catch you soon
meanings.note: Pinyin: huítóu jiàn. Casual, friendly parting phrase where 回头 figuratively means 'in a little while' or 'later on'; common among coworkers and friends expecting to meet again soon.

examples.text: 我先去开会了，咱们回头见！
examples.trans: I'm heading off to my meeting first — see you later!

examples.text: 今天聊得很开心，回头见！
examples.trans: It was great chatting today; see you soon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wéi qún. Combines 围 ('wrap around') + 裙 ('skirt/apron'); measure word: 条 (tiáo).

examples.text: 解下围裙吧——星期五六点到了！
examples.trans: Untie your aprons—six o'clock on Friday is here!

examples.text: 小美系上干净的白围裙，开始在厨房里揉面团。
examples.trans: Mei tied on a clean white apron and began kneading dough in the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个夏天 ('a summer').

examples.text: 房东律师寄来的？奇怪——我们房租一直交到明年夏天了。
examples.trans: Sent by the landlord's lawyer? Strange—our rent is paid right through next summer.

examples.text: 夏天坐在大树底下乘凉最舒服。
examples.trans: Sitting in the shade beneath the big tree in summer is bliss.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà. Everyday adjective for size, age, and strong wind or rain.

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà mén. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇大门 ('a front gate').

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

examples.text: 老陈，你听到了吗？有人按了大门门铃！
examples.trans: Chen, did you hear that? Someone rang the front gate bell!

meanings.note: Pinyin: tài yáng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个太阳 ('a sun').

examples.text: 热面包，热茶，早上的太阳，一点冷风也没有！
examples.trans: Warm bread, hot tea, morning sun, and not a bit of cold wind!

examples.text: 今天太阳很好，我们去院子里坐坐吧。
examples.trans: The sun is lovely today; let's go and sit in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiā. First-tone jiā: hold something pinched between two surfaces, such as under one's arm (夹在胳膊底下) or inside book pages.

examples.text: 周经理把绿色登记本夹在胳膊底下走来走去。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou paced back and forth with the green guest book tucked under his arm.

examples.text: 她在旧书里夹了一片干树叶做书签。
examples.trans: She tucked a dried leaf inside the old book as a bookmark.

安.gloss: to install; fit; set in place

meanings.en: to install or mount hardware; to put calmly in place
meanings.note: Pinyin: ān. Everyday spoken verb equivalent to 安装 (install) when fitting fans, hooks, or shelves.

examples.text: 感受一下大树底下这阵凉风——老天爷亲自给咱们安了个降温扇！
examples.trans: Feel this gentle breeze under the tree—nature went ahead and built us our own cooling fan!

examples.text: 三十年前建小院时，木匠就在横梁上安了四个铁环。
examples.trans: When the inn was built thirty years ago, the carpenter mounted four iron rings along the beam.

meanings.note: Noun bǎoshí ('precious or artificial stone').

examples.text: 他在舞台上没有看到那颗宝石。
examples.trans: He did not see that gemstone on the stage.

examples.text: 这颗蓝色的宝石真漂亮。
examples.trans: This blue gemstone is lovely.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo qíng. Friendly name of Courtyard Inn's new receptionist.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiáo měi. Friendly name of Courtyard Inn's baker and barista.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
examples.trans: Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Highlights immediacy, exact location (就在这里), or smooth consequence ('then').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dài. Used for carrying keys, tools, or luggage with you.

examples.text: 这么快就修好了？老陈你随身带着螺丝刀啊！
examples.trans: Fixed that fast? Chen, you carry a screwdriver everywhere on you!

examples.text: 说实话，我选这一带，也是为了一桩家里的旧事。
examples.trans: Honestly, I also chose this neighbourhood for an old family matter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nián. Time classifier taking no 个 directly after numbers (六年 'six years', 今年 'this year').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǐ xia. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最底下 ('the bottom').

examples.text: 看车轮底下——铅笔写的你和我的名字还在那儿。
examples.trans: Look underneath the wheels—your name and mine in pencil are still right there.

examples.text: 前面锁扣有个小锁孔，再看底下贴着：一把旧铜钥匙！
examples.trans: There is a tiny keyhole on the front latch, and taped underneath: an old brass key!

meanings.en: younger brother (affectionate short form of 弟弟)
meanings.note: Pinyin: dì. Often used in direct address ('弟') or with 我弟 ('my younger brother') in warm sibling speech.

examples.text: 两点二十八分！我跟我弟现在就得去中央车站啦！
examples.trans: Twenty-eight past two! My little brother and I need to head for Central Station right now!

examples.text: 志鹏拍拍我弟的肩膀，说好一起抬起沉甸甸的木隔条。
examples.trans: Peng patted his younger brother on the shoulder as they lifted the wooden spacer bars together.

张.gloss: measure word for flat surfaces and paper

meanings.en: measure word for flat surfaces and paper
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhāng. Counts tables, beds, paper sheets, tickets, receipts, and luggage tags (一张桌子, 一张纸).

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 旁边的把手上系着一张小纸牌。
examples.trans: There is a small paper card tied on the side handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dāng. Means 'act in the role of' (当哥哥 'be an older brother', 当前台主管 'serve as front-desk manager').

examples.text: 老陈，你真懂当哥哥的人。
examples.trans: Chen, you really understand older brothers.

examples.text: 别抢人，小美！小晴，你愿意留下来当正式前台主管吗？
examples.trans: No poaching, Mei! Qing, are you willing to stay on as our permanent front-desk manager?

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎng wài. Directional phrase 往 ('toward') + 外 ('outside').

examples.text: 透过擦干净的拱窗往外看，整个院子绿油油的。
examples.trans: Looking outward through the clean arched window, the whole courtyard is lush green.

examples.text: 这两扇木头窗板是往外推开的。
examples.trans: These two wooden shutters swing open outward.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Read de after a verb to introduce how it goes (走得快 'walk fast'); read děi before a verb to mean 'must'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīn. Measure word (量词): 颗 (kē), e.g. 一颗心 ('a heart').

examples.text: 我心跳得好快！小晴你去说，你声音稳重诚实！
examples.trans: My heart is pounding! Qing, you explain it—you sound calm and honest!

examples.text: 志鹏不会走的。他总是嘴硬五秒钟，心马上就软了。
examples.trans: Zhipeng will not leave. He always talked tough for five seconds, then softened right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhì péng. Given name of Zhihao's younger brother.

examples.text: 白纸里面包的东西是给我哥哥志鹏的，不是我的。
examples.trans: What is wrapped inside that white paper is for my brother Zhipeng, not mine.

examples.text: 您为什么不直接去志鹏家门口把木头小火车交给他呢？
examples.trans: Why not go straight to Zhipeng's door and hand him the wooden train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. As an adjective/adverb, 'fast/quickly'; in 快…了, 'about to'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

meanings.note: Noun/verb gǎnshòu ('how someone feels; experience').

examples.text: 你在派对上黑着脸，有想过我的感受吗？
examples.trans: Frowning through the party, did you consider my feelings?

examples.text: 做真人秀最看重嘉宾在镜头前真实的感受。
examples.trans: Reality TV prizes guests' genuine feelings on camera.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

扇.gloss: measure word for doors and windows

meanings.en: measure word for doors and windows
meanings.note: Pinyin: shàn. Counts hinged or sliding doors and windows (一扇门 'a door', 一扇窗户 'a window').

examples.text: 上楼梯，平台往左拐，最上面最后一扇门。
examples.trans: Up the stairs, turn left at the landing, last door at the very top.

examples.text: 再往左拐进小广场，找一扇蓝木门。
examples.trans: Then turn left into the small square and look for a blue wooden door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shǒu. Measure word (量词): 双 (shuāng), e.g. 一双手 ('a pair of hands').

examples.text: 谢谢你，小美。刚才吓了一跳，手都凉了！
examples.trans: Thank you, Mei. That gave me such a start just now that my hands went cold!

examples.text: 我手在发抖——车上下来穿深灰色外套的高个子男人吗？
examples.trans: My hands are shaking—is a tall man in a dark grey coat stepping out?

related.gloss: a pair of hands (measure word 双)

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: In 抛出来, means pitching a bold new idea or plan.

examples.text: 他在会上抛出了一个大胆的新方案。
examples.trans: At the meeting he pitched a bold new proposal.

examples.text: 这个问题一抛出来，大家都沉默了。
examples.trans: The moment this question was tossed out, everyone fell silent.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a verb used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个拌。
examples.trans: I have a 拌.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的拌。
examples.trans: This is a very good 拌.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guà zhōng. Combines 挂 ('hang on a wall') + 钟 ('clock').

examples.text: 前台后面的老挂钟每到整点就会轻轻敲响。
examples.trans: The old wall clock behind the front desk chimes softly every hour on the hour.

examples.text: 老陈修好了大堂里那座停了很久的挂钟。
examples.trans: Chen repaired the wall clock in the lobby that had been stopped for a long time.

examples.text: 他在口袋里摸了半天，终于找出了大门的钥匙。
examples.trans: He felt around in his pocket for a while and finally pulled out the key to the front gate.

examples.text: 猫儿顺着墙角轻轻走过来，用脑袋蹭着摸她的手背。
examples.trans: The cat padded softly along the corner of the wall and brushed its head against the back of her hand.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sǎ. Used for sprinkling powdered sugar or salt over food.

examples.text: 好。端上去之前，在上面撒这些新鲜绿香草。
examples.trans: Good. Before serving them, sprinkle these fresh green herbs on top.

examples.text: 他爷爷会切热柠檬蛋糕，上面撒一层白糖粉！
examples.trans: His grandfather sliced warm lemon cake with a dusting of powdered sugar on top!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěng gè. Combines 整 ('whole') + 个; modifies singular nouns directly without another measure word (整个中央八度).

examples.text: 修好那根琴槌以后，宋老师给整个中央八度调了音。
examples.trans: After fixing that hammer, Teacher Song tuned the entire middle octave.

examples.text: 柠檬挞的香味飘满了整个咖啡角。
examples.trans: The aroma of lemon tart drifted through the entire café corner.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì bú shì. A-not-A affirmative-negative question tag; bù shifts to bú before 4th-tone shì.

examples.text: 我们俩是不是刚升职当上正式试吃员了？
examples.trans: Did the two of us just get promoted to official taste testers?

examples.text: 你是不是把绿色登记本夹在胳膊底下了？
examples.trans: Didn't you tuck the green guest book under your arm?

meanings.en: pleasantly toasty and cozy (of sunshine, ovens, or blankets)
meanings.note: Pinyin: nuǎn hōng hōng. Expressive ABB adjective built on 暖 (warm) + 烘烘 (oven-like warmth).

examples.text: 整个院子都飘着烤杏仁、熟浆果，还有夏天太阳暖烘烘的甜香味儿！
examples.trans: The whole courtyard is drifting with roasted almonds, ripe berries, and warm summer sunshine!

examples.text: 刚烤好的蛋糕端进大堂，连带着四周空气都暖烘烘的。
examples.trans: When the freshly baked cakes were carried into the lobby, even the air around them felt cozy and warm.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xìng rén. Combines 杏 ('apricot/almond') + 仁 ('nut kernel').

examples.text: 小美端来了一盘刚出炉的温热杏仁饼干。
examples.trans: Mei brought over a plate of warm almond biscuits fresh from the oven.

examples.text: 用杏仁粉做的柠檬挞底吃起来特别香酥。
examples.trans: A lemon tart crust made with ground almonds tastes wonderfully crisp and nutty.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lái. Movement toward the speaker, as main verb or directional complement (进来 'come in').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shù. Measure word (量词): 棵, e.g. 一棵树 ('a tree').

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

examples.text: 只有院子里的老树和雨声。
examples.trans: Only the old tree in the courtyard and the sound of rain.

meanings.en: birch timber; pale fine-grained birch wood
meanings.note: Pinyin: huà mù. Prized for smooth, splinter-free wooden clothespins, dowels, and small craft items.

examples.text: 周经理，等一下——你看这原色桦木做得多光滑、多干净！
examples.trans: Hold on a second, Zhou—look how smooth and clean this natural birch wood is!

examples.text: 再低头看餐桌：二十八条亚麻餐巾全被编好号的桦木夹咬得死死的！
examples.trans: And look down at the tables: all twenty-eight linen napkins are clamped tight by numbered birch pins!

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个橙皮 ('a 橙皮').

examples.text: 我有一个橙皮。
examples.trans: I have a 橙皮.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的橙皮。
examples.trans: This is a very good 橙皮.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huān yíng. Warm greeting to arriving guests (欢迎！ / 欢迎光临！).

examples.text: 大家早上好！欢迎你，小晴。都准备好了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning, everyone! Welcome, Qing. Is everything ready?

examples.text: 欢迎光临！早上好，您好！
examples.trans: Welcome! Good morning, hello!

meanings.en: right in the middle of; squarely; right
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèng. Before a verb, marks an action in progress right now; before 对着, means 'directly/squarely'.

examples.text: 正合我心意。楼梯在哪儿？
examples.trans: Just what I wanted. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

meanings.note: Pinyin: měi. Usually followed by a measure word (每个星期 'every week', 每位客人 'every guest').

examples.text: 每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
examples.trans: Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

meanings.en: not have; there is not; did not
meanings.note: Pinyin: méi yǒu. Negates 有 ('have / there is') and past actions.

examples.text: 可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
examples.trans: Unfortunately there is no phone number, only two letters and an old street name.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiāng guǒ. Measure word: 颗 (kē) for a single berry, e.g. 一颗红浆果 ('a red berry').

examples.text: 搭档，趁浆果蛋糕在树荫下放凉，咱们从头再来一遍！
examples.trans: Partner, let us take it from the top one more time while those berry cakes cool in the shade!

examples.text: 小美一早就挑了最新鲜的浆果，准备烤给大家配红茶吃。
examples.trans: First thing in the morning Mei picked the freshest berries to bake for everyone with black tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wēn. Describes lukewarm water or mild temperatures.

examples.text: 摸摸热水管——下面是温的，上面变凉了。
examples.trans: Feel the hot-water pipe—the bottom is warm, while the top is turning cool.

examples.text: 壶里的水还是温的，正好喝。
examples.trans: The water in the pot is still warm—just right to drink.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wēn rè. Combines 温 ('mildly warm') + 热 ('hot'): gently warm to the touch or taste without burning.

examples.text: 盘子里装着刚出炉、还带着温热的杏仁饼干。
examples.trans: On the plate are freshly baked almond biscuits that are still warm.

examples.text: 喝一口温热的薄荷茶，整个人都放松下来了。
examples.trans: After a sip of warm mint tea, you feel completely relaxed.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mǎn. Describes a full cup or a fully booked hotel.

examples.text: 外面下着大雨，街上酒店全满了！我们怎么办？
examples.trans: It is pouring rain outside and every hotel on the street is full! What do we do?

examples.text: 啊……下这么大的雨，车站附近酒店全满了。
examples.trans: Ah... in rain this heavy, every hotel near the station was full.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diǎn. Marks hours on the clock (八点 'eight o'clock') or 'a bit' (一点).

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kǎo. Used for baking bread, rolls, and cakes in an oven.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

examples.text: 多烤几块边角，好姑娘！
examples.trans: Bake plenty of corner pieces, dear girl!

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个烤盘 ('a 烤盘').

examples.text: 我有一个烤盘。
examples.trans: I have a 烤盘.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的烤盘。
examples.trans: This is a very good 烤盘.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tàng. Describes piping-hot tea/soup or ironing clothes neat (烫好).

examples.text: 茶壶也烫好了！大家从窗边退后一步！
examples.trans: And the teapot is hot! Everybody step back from the window!

examples.text: 汤刚出锅，小心很烫。
examples.trans: The soup just came off the stove—careful, it is piping hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rè. Describes hot tea, hot water, or warm weather.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.note: Adjective shú ('well acquainted with').

examples.text: 您上周还说我熟那边。
examples.trans: Last week you said I knew that area well.

examples.text: 我跟这儿的同事都很熟。
examples.trans: I know the colleagues here very well.

片.gloss: measure word for slices, leaves, tablets

meanings.en: measure word for slices, leaves, tablets
meanings.note: Pinyin: piàn. Counts thin, flat slices of bread, lemon, cheese, or leaves (一片面包 'a slice of bread').

examples.text: 请给我不加糖的红茶，再来一片热面包。
examples.trans: Black tea without added sugar, please, and one slice of warm bread.

examples.text: 他在红茶里放了一片新鲜柠檬。
examples.trans: He put a slice of fresh lemon into his black tea.

meanings.note: Used literally for cards or figuratively for leverage.

examples.text: 这是我们谈判手里最后一张牌了。
examples.trans: This is the very last card in our hand for the talks.

examples.text: 把好牌打好，才能赢得最后的胜利。
examples.trans: Only by playing good cards well can you win in the end.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàn zài. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 现在这时候 ('this moment right now').

examples.text: 现在他的箱子还安全锁着呢。
examples.trans: For now, his suitcase stays safely locked up.

examples.text: 太好了！现在我想吃一顿丰盛的早餐。
examples.trans: Wonderful! Now I would like to eat a big breakfast.

related.gloss: this moment right now (measure word 个)

meanings.note: Pinyin: tián. Describes sweet pastries, fruit, or tea with honey.

examples.text: 那是海盐咸黄油！甜果酱面包卷要无盐黄油！
examples.trans: That is sea-salt butter! Sweet jam rolls need unsalted butter!

examples.text: 咸黄油能配甜草莓果酱吗？
examples.trans: Can salted butter go with sweet strawberry jam?

meanings.note: Pinyin: huà. Used for drawing blueprints or painting signs.

examples.text: 上面怎么用铅笔整齐画了这条街三家客栈？
examples.trans: Why are three inns on this street neatly sketched in pencil on it?

examples.text: 门上方只画着一把金色钥匙。拿旧阀门给店员看。
examples.trans: Only a golden key painted above the door. Show the clerk the old valve.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bái. Describes white paper, sugar, or tablecloths.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

examples.text: 看，把手上贴着一个白信封。
examples.trans: Look, there is a white envelope taped onto the handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhe. Placed right after a verb to show a state or posture continues (门开着 'the door stands open').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Verb/adjective suì ('shatter into fragments').

examples.text: 那一刻，她心里的偶像碎了。
examples.trans: In that moment, the idol in her heart shattered.

examples.text: 小心别把玻璃杯摔碎了。
examples.trans: Be careful not to shatter the glass.

meanings.en: secret recipe or closely guarded formula
meanings.note: Pinyin: mì fāng. Measure word: 张 (zhāng) for a written sheet or 个 (gè).

examples.text: 贴手心刚好温温的，小美——可以刷你那三十年秘方糖蜜啦！
examples.trans: Just warm against my palm, Mei—ready for your thirty-year secret honey glaze!

examples.text: 这张柑橘蜂蜜蛋糕的秘方，小美用防水塑料封得严严实实。
examples.trans: Mei laminated that secret orange-honey cake recipe in waterproof plastic.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wén wěn. Reduplicated adverb describing steady hands or footing.

examples.text: 火苗亮了——稳稳的蓝火，正合适。
examples.trans: The flame is lit—steady blue fire, right as it should be.

examples.text: 她双手稳稳地端起盛满热茶的托盘。
examples.trans: With both hands she lifted the tray of hot tea steadily.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duān. Specifically describes carrying dishes, soup, or tea level in the hands.

examples.text: 好。端上去之前，在上面撒这些新鲜绿香草。
examples.trans: Good. Before serving them, sprinkle these fresh green herbs on top.

examples.text: 她端着一盘热面包走出来。
examples.trans: She walked out carrying a tray of warm bread.

meanings.en: pastries; cakes and baked sweet snacks
meanings.note: Pinyin: gāo diǎn. Collective noun; individual pieces take 块 (kuài) or 份 (fèn).

examples.text: 我把拌了甜橙皮碎的热蜂蜜端来了，还带了两把糕点刷！
examples.trans: Here is the warm honey stirred with sweet orange zest, plus two pastry brushes!

examples.text: 小美烤的时令糕点配上一壶热薄荷茶，客人们都赞不绝口。
examples.trans: Mei's seasonal pastries paired with a pot of hot mint tea drew nonstop praise from the guests.

meanings.en: sweet honeyed glaze or syrup; molasses
meanings.note: Pinyin: táng mì. Mass noun measured by 碗 (wǎn, 'bowl') or 勺 (sháo, 'spoonful').

examples.text: 贴手心刚好温温的，小美——可以刷你那三十年秘方糖蜜啦！
examples.trans: Just warm against my palm, Mei—ready for your thirty-year secret honey glaze!

examples.text: 蛋糕表面刷了一层橙香糖蜜，在树荫下亮得像金子一样。
examples.trans: Brushed with a coat of orange-scented honey glaze, the cakes gleamed like gold in the shade.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jǐn. Describes tightening a valve (拧紧) or a tight schedule.

examples.text: 当心那把角落椅子，等十秒我拧紧螺丝。
examples.trans: Mind that corner chair—wait ten seconds while I tighten the screw.

examples.text: 小晴，把床单角塞紧！放上两个软枕头。
examples.trans: Qing, tuck the sheet corner tight! On go the two soft pillows.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hóng. Describes the color red; note that 红茶 is what English calls 'black tea'.

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

examples.text: 我的行李箱！快打开上面口袋……对，红丝带！
examples.trans: My suitcase! Let me open the top pocket... yes, the red ribbon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: gěi. As main verb, 'give'; as preposition/complement, marks the recipient (给你 'for/to you', 递给我 'pass to me').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

meanings.note: Pinyin: luó pán. Measure word (量词): 面 (miàn) or 个 (gè). Joins 罗 ('net, to gather') + 盘 ('plate, tray').

examples.text: 抽屉深处藏着一面古董航海罗盘。
examples.trans: Hidden deep in the drawer is an antique nautical compass.

examples.text: 制图员教授当年就是用这面罗盘在山里测绘的。
examples.trans: The mapmaker professor used this very compass to survey in the mountains back in the day.

meanings.en: Heaven; Old Man Sky; colloquial personification of weather or fate
meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo tiān yé. Warm, everyday spoken expression for thanking good weather or luck.

examples.text: 感受一下大树底下这阵凉风——老天爷亲自给咱们安了个降温扇！
examples.trans: Feel this gentle breeze under the tree—nature went ahead and built us our own cooling fan!

examples.text: 老天爷真照应小院客栈，连着三天都是不冷不热的晴天。
examples.trans: Heaven really looked out for Courtyard Inn, giving us three mild, sunny days in a row.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tuō. Opposite of 穿; often pairs with 掉 (脱掉 'take off').

examples.text: 坐下吧，志鹏，脱掉厚外套，看看这个蓝色行李箱。
examples.trans: Sit down, Zhipeng, take off your heavy coat, and look at this blue suitcase.

examples.text: 进屋很暖和，把厚外套脱掉吧。
examples.trans: It is warm inside—take off your heavy coat.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dàn gāo. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块蛋糕 ('a piece of cake').

examples.text: 他爷爷会切热柠檬蛋糕，上面撒一层白糖粉！
examples.trans: His grandfather sliced warm lemon cake with a dusting of powdered sugar on top!

examples.text: 十一点二十分。小美，蛋糕好了吗？
examples.trans: Eleven twenty. Mei, is the cake ready?

related.gloss: a piece of cake (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēng mì. Measure word (量词): 勺, e.g. 一勺蜂蜜 ('a spoonful of honey').

examples.text: 宋老师，给您热薄荷茶和蜂蜜。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, here is hot mint tea and honey for you.

examples.text: 太明智了！旁边要配蜂蜜还是苹果果酱？
examples.trans: Wise choice! Would you like honey or apple jam on the side?

related.gloss: a spoonful of honey (measure word 勺)

meanings.note: Pinyin: yī jiā. Measure word: 个 (gè) or 只 (zhī), e.g. 二十八个桦木衣夹 ('twenty-eight birch clothespins').

examples.text: 走，下楼吧——前台还有三十个木衣夹等着小晴呢。
examples.trans: Come on downstairs—I have thirty wooden clothespins waiting for Qing at the front desk.

examples.text: 小晴把九号衣夹放进铁盒前，先让院子里的每个人都在背面签了名。
examples.trans: Before placing clothespin number nine into the tin box, Qing had everyone in the courtyard sign its back.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liè. Describes cracked porcelain, wood, or pipes.

examples.text: 坏消息。老热水器上的铜压力阀门裂了。
examples.trans: Bad news. The brass pressure valve on the old water heater cracked.

examples.text: 旧茶杯边上裂了一道小口子。
examples.trans: A tiny crack appeared on the rim of the old teacup.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ràng. Everyday causative/polite-offer verb (让我看看 'let me have a look').

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 宋老师，让我来给您倒新鲜橙汁！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, allow me to pour fresh orange juice for you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiē. Used for taping envelopes, labels, or notices onto a surface.

examples.text: 看，把手上贴着一个白信封。
examples.trans: Look, there is a white envelope taped onto the handle.

examples.text: 对。我一慌，按了门铃，把星期五纸条贴在把手上。
examples.trans: Yes. In a panic I rang the bell and taped the Friday note onto the handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gēn. As a verb, 'follow' (跟我来 'follow me'); as a preposition, 'with' (跟你一样 'same as yours').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.en: to work under; to shadow or apprentice with
meanings.note: gēnzhe — 跟 + durative aspect particle 着; idiomatic in professional settings for working on a mentor's or boss's team
indicates accompanying someone physically or acting immediately in sequence

examples.text: 跟着我，肯定是上十二歌王了。
examples.trans: Working under me, it will definitely be on Twelve Singers.

examples.text: 你这几天就跟着杏子姐姐，给她打打下手。
examples.trans: For the next few days, shadow Sister Xingzi and lend her a hand.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chē zhàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个车站 ('a station').

examples.text: 啊……下这么大的雨，车站附近酒店全满了。
examples.trans: Ah... in rain this heavy, every hotel near the station was full.

examples.text: 雨天打车难，我们早点去车站吧。
examples.trans: Hailing a cab in the rain takes longer, so let's head to the station early.

related.gloss: be stuck in a traffic jam

meanings.note: Pinyin: qīng qīng. Reduplication of 轻 ('light/soft'), used directly before short verbs or with 地 (轻轻地抽出来).

examples.text: 宋老师用两根手指把旧乐谱轻轻抽了出来。
examples.trans: Teacher Song gently slid the old music sheet out with two fingers.

examples.text: 怕吵醒午睡的客人，小晴轻轻关上了木门。
examples.trans: So as not to wake guests napping at noon, Qing closed the wooden door softly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: biān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一边 ('one side').

examples.text: 对，过了桥，右手边会经过一家绿药店。
examples.trans: Right, after crossing the bridge, you pass a green pharmacy on your right.

examples.text: 快坐在向阳窗户边，宋老师！先别急着上楼！
examples.trans: Sit right down by the sunny window, Teacher Song! No rush to go back upstairs yet!

meanings.note: Pinyin: guò. Read neutral-tone guo after a verb for 'have ever done' (见过); read guò as a verb meaning 'cross/pass' (过河 'cross the river').

examples.text: 早跟你说过，那个平板是个坑。
examples.trans: Told you before, that tablet is a trap.

examples.text: 出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
examples.trans: Left out the gate, straight to the bridge. Do I cross the river?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái. Everyday adverb meaning 'still' (还在), 'not yet' (还没), or 'even more' after 比.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

meanings.en: and also; in addition; still have
meanings.note: Pinyin: hái yǒu. Adds another item to a list ('plus…').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè. Proximal demonstrative; pairs with a measure word before nouns (这个 'this one', 这间房 'this room').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà. Distal demonstrative before measure words (那个 'that one'); at clause start, means 'then / well then'.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nàr. Spoken variant of 那里 ('there').

examples.text: 因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
examples.trans: Because the stairs are narrow, and Manager Zhou put old lamp boxes up there.

examples.text: 看车轮底下——铅笔写的你和我的名字还在那儿。
examples.trans: Look underneath the wheels—your name and mine in pencil are still right there.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōu. Summarizes everything BEFORE it and always stands directly before the verb/adjective (我们都喜欢).

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīn huáng. Praises freshly baked pastry crusts.

examples.text: 正在架子上放凉呢——金黄外皮配甜柠檬糖霜！
examples.trans: Cooling on the rack right now—golden crust with sweet lemon glaze!

examples.text: 刚烤出来的面包卷外皮一片金黄。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls came out golden-brown.

meanings.en: measure word for a passing spell, gust of wind, burst of applause, or shower
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèn. Used in 一阵风 ('a gust of wind') and 一阵掌声 ('a burst of applause').

examples.text: 刚才从街口拱门吹过来的那阵凉风，你们感觉到了吗？
examples.trans: Did you feel that cool gust blowing through the street arch just now?

examples.text: 琴声刚落，树荫底下就响起了一阵热烈又长久的掌声。
examples.trans: As soon as the piano stopped, a warm, lingering burst of applause rose from under the shade tree.

meanings.en: to cool down; drop in temperature (weather or objects)
meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàng wēn. Note jiàng ('descend') vs xiáng ('surrender'); modifies nouns in 降温扇 ('cooling fan').

examples.text: 感受一下大树底下这阵凉风——老天爷亲自给咱们安了个降温扇！
examples.trans: Feel this gentle breeze under the tree—nature went ahead and built us our own cooling fan!

examples.text: 太阳落山后院子里很快降温了，坐在树下喝茶舒服极了。
examples.trans: After sunset the courtyard cooled down quickly, making tea under the tree wonderfully comfortable.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuàn zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个院子 ('a courtyard').

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Verb dǐng ('cover a post temporarily; withstand').

examples.text: 总编室真的得找个人来顶你的班。
examples.trans: The office really must find someone to cover your post.

examples.text: 关键时刻多亏有前辈在前面顶着。
examples.trans: At the crunch moment, senior staff held the line.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǐng shang. Combines 顶 ('summit/crown/top') + neutral-tone locality suffix 上.

examples.text: 我和志豪站在木梯子上，正好能够到顶上的拱窗。
examples.trans: Standing on the wooden ladder, Hao and I can reach the arched window at the top.

examples.text: 书架顶上放着一只装旧照片的木盒子。
examples.trans: On top of the bookcase sits a wooden box of old photographs.

颗.gloss: measure word for small round things

meanings.en: measure word for small round things
meanings.note: Pinyin: kē. Counts stars, pearls, beans, buttons, and hearts (一颗星 'a star').

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

examples.text: 小盘子里放着五颗新鲜草莓。
examples.trans: Five fresh strawberries sit on the small plate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēng. Measure word (量词): 阵, e.g. 一阵风 ('a gust of wind').

examples.text: 热汤？在冷雨中走过来之后，这听起来太棒了。
examples.trans: Hot soup? After that cold walk in the rain, that sounds wonderful.

examples.text: 春天下午的风又轻又暖。
examples.trans: The spring afternoon breeze is gentle and warm.

related.gloss: a gust of wind (measure word 阵)

meanings.note: Pinyin: piāo. Describes music, fragrance, leaves, or clouds floating gently through the air (飘出去 'drift out', 飘到树底下 'float out under the tree').

examples.text: 把对着院子的两扇拱窗敞开吧，让钢琴声飘到外面的梧桐巷去。
examples.trans: Open wide the two arched windows facing the courtyard so the piano music can drift out to Wutong Lane.

examples.text: 开头的四个音符从阳光房飘出来，一直飘到院子的大树底下。
examples.trans: The opening four notes floated out from the sunroom all the way under the big courtyard tree.

meanings.note: Pinyin: cān jīn. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张餐巾 ('a napkin').

examples.text: 小勺子和餐巾放在哪里？
examples.trans: Where do the small spoons and napkins go?

examples.text: 每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
examples.trans: Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiāng. Puts warm praise on fragrant tea/bread and even deep, restful sleep (睡得香).

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
examples.trans: Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!

examples.text: 这是我这个月睡得最香的一晚，洗澡水也热极了！
examples.trans: Best sleep I have had all month, and the shower water was wonderfully hot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiāng wèi. Measure word (量词): 股, e.g. 一股香味 ('a waft of aroma').

examples.text: 早上好！在楼上就闻到暖暖的肉桂香味了！
examples.trans: Good morning! All the way upstairs I smelled warm cinnamon!

examples.text: 热黄油和肉桂的香味飘到了院子里。
examples.trans: The aroma of warm butter and cinnamon drifted out into the courtyard.

related.gloss: a waft of aroma (measure word 股)

meanings.note: Pinyin: huáng tóng. Literally 黄 ('yellow/golden') + 铜 ('copper/bronze'): copper-zinc brass alloy.

examples.text: 钢琴琴槌里面的细小轴销是用结实的黄铜做的。
examples.trans: The tiny hinge pins inside piano hammers are made of sturdy brass.

examples.text: 老陈把前台的黄铜小铃铛擦得金光发亮。
examples.trans: Chen polished the little brass bell on the front desk until it gleamed.
